subject: Physics
title: Electrostatics
summary: Charge ke teen gun: quantised (q = ne), conserved (na banta na mitta) aur additive (seedha jod lo, sign ke saath). Do charges ke beech force Coulomb's law se aati hai — 1/r² wali, aur line joining ke along.

Electric field E = force per unit positive test charge. Kai charges ho to har ek ka field vector ki tarah jodo (superposition). Lagatar faile charge (rod, ring, sheet) ke liye chhote tukde dq lekar integrate karo.
Gauss's law: band surface se nikla total flux = andar ka charge / ε₀. Jahaan symmetry ho (line, sheet, sphere) wahaan ye field nikaalne ka sabse tez tareeka hai.
Potential V ek scalar hai (sirf jodna, direction nahi) aur E = −dV/dr. Field hamesha potential ghatne ki taraf hota hai. Equipotential surfaces field lines ke perpendicular hoti hain.
Conductor ke andar electrostatic field zero hota hai, saara extra charge surface par rehta hai, aur poora conductor ek hi potential par hota hai.

Capacitor charge aur energy store karta hai: C = Q/V. Parallel plate C = Kε₀A/d. Series mein Q same, parallel mein V same — resistors ka bilkul ulta pattern. Dielectric daalne par kya badalta hai, ye battery juddi hai ya nahi us par depend karta hai.

formulas.name: Coulomb's law
formulas.formula: F = k q₁q₂ / r²,   k = 1/(4πε₀) ≈ 9 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²,   ε₀ = 8.85 × 10⁻¹² C²/(N·m²)
formulas.when: Do point charges ke beech force (vacuum/hawa).
formulas.mistake: q ko sign ke saath daalo sirf direction samajhne ke liye; magnitude ke liye |q| lo.

formulas.name: Coulomb's law in a medium
formulas.formula: F_medium = F_vacuum / K   (K = dielectric constant = ε/ε₀)
formulas.when: Charges kisi medium (paani, oil) mein ho.
formulas.note: K hamesha ≥ 1, isliye medium mein force kam hoti hai.

formulas.name: Quantisation and conservation
formulas.formula: q = n e,   e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C,   n integer
formulas.when: Kitne electrons gaye/aaye; charge e ka integer multiple hi hoga.

formulas.name: Superposition
formulas.formula: F_net = F₁ + F₂ + …   (vector sum),   E_net = Σ Eᵢ
formulas.when: Teen ya zyada charges; har pair ka force alag nikaalo, phir vector jodo.

formulas.name: Field of a point charge
formulas.formula: E = F/q₀ = k q / r²   (q se door, agar q positive)
formulas.when: Kisi point par field.

formulas.name: Continuous charge distribution
formulas.formula: dq = λ dl,  σ dA,  ρ dV;    E = ∫ k dq / r²  (direction ka dhyan rakh ke)
formulas.when: Rod, ring, disc jaise lagatar charge.
formulas.mistake: Symmetry se cancel hone wale components pehle hata do.

formulas.name: Ring of charge on its axis
formulas.formula: E = k Q x / (x² + R²)^{3/2};   centre par E = 0;   E_max at x = R/√2
formulas.when: Ring ke axis par kisi point par field.

formulas.name: Electric dipole moment
formulas.formula: p = q × (2a),   direction −q se +q ki taraf
formulas.when: Do barabar-ulte charges, beech ki doori 2a.

formulas.name: Dipole field (r ≫ a)
formulas.formula: Axial: E = 2kp/r³ (p ki direction).   Equatorial: E = kp/r³ (p ke ulta).   General: E = (kp/r³)√(1 + 3cos²θ)
formulas.when: Dipole se door field.
formulas.note: Dipole field 1/r³ se girta hai, point charge 1/r² se.

formulas.name: Dipole in uniform field
formulas.formula: τ = p × E,  |τ| = pE sinθ;   net force F = 0
formulas.when: Uniform field mein dipole sirf ghoomta hai.
formulas.note: Non-uniform field mein net force bhi lagta hai.

formulas.name: Dipole potential energy
formulas.formula: U = −p·E = −pE cosθ;   W(θ₁→θ₂) = pE (cosθ₁ − cosθ₂)
formulas.when: Dipole ko ghumane ka kaam, stable/unstable position.
formulas.note: θ = 0 stable (U = −pE), θ = 180° unstable (U = +pE). 0 se 180° tak kaam = 2pE.

formulas.name: Electric flux
formulas.formula: Φ = ∮ E·dA = E A cosθ  (uniform field, flat surface)
formulas.when: Surface se kitni field lines guzarti hain.
formulas.note: θ = field aur area vector (normal) ke beech ka angle.

formulas.name: Gauss's law
formulas.formula: Φ_closed = q_enclosed / ε₀
formulas.when: Band surface; sirf andar ke charge se flux.
formulas.mistake: Bahar ke charges flux nahi badalte, lekin surface par E zaroor badalte hain.

formulas.name: Infinite line charge
formulas.formula: E = λ / (2πε₀ r) = 2kλ / r
formulas.when: Lambi seedhi wire (Gauss: cylinder).

formulas.name: Infinite plane sheet
formulas.formula: E = σ / (2ε₀)  (r se independent).   Do ulte charged plates ke beech: E = σ/ε₀, bahar 0
formulas.when: Bade flat sheet ke paas field.
formulas.mistake: Conductor surface ke just bahar E = σ/ε₀ hota hai, σ/2ε₀ nahi.

formulas.name: Thin spherical shell (charge Q)
formulas.formula: r > R: E = kQ/r²,  V = kQ/r.   r = R: E = kQ/R².   r < R: E = 0,  V = kQ/R (constant)
formulas.when: Shell ya conducting sphere.
formulas.mistake: Andar E zero hai, V zero nahi.

formulas.name: Uniformly charged solid sphere (non-conducting)
formulas.formula: r < R: E = kQr/R³ (r ke saath badhta hai);   r ≥ R: E = kQ/r²
formulas.when: Insulating solid sphere — JEE mein Gauss ki practice ke liye aata hai.

formulas.name: Potential and field
formulas.formula: V = kq/r;   V_A − V_B = −∫_B^A E·dr;   E = −dV/dr  (E_x = −∂V/∂x)
formulas.when: Field se potential ya potential se field.
formulas.note: V scalar hai: kai charges ka V seedha jodo (sign ke saath).

formulas.name: Dipole potential
formulas.formula: V = k p cosθ / r²;   equatorial line par V = 0
formulas.when: Dipole se door potential.
formulas.mistake: Equatorial par V = 0 hai lekin E zero nahi.

formulas.name: Potential energy of charges
formulas.formula: Do charges: U = k q₁q₂ / r.   System: U = Σ (har pair) k qᵢqⱼ / rᵢⱼ
formulas.when: System banane ka kaam.
formulas.mistake: Har pair sirf ek baar gino (3 charges = 3 pairs).

formulas.name: Work and energy in a field
formulas.formula: W_ext = q ΔV;   charge V volt se accelerate: K = qV  (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J)
formulas.when: Charge ko ek point se doosre le jaana / accelerate karna.

formulas.name: Capacitance
formulas.formula: C = Q/V.   Parallel plate: C = ε₀A/d.   Isolated sphere: C = 4πε₀R
formulas.when: Capacitor ki capacity.

formulas.name: Capacitor with dielectric
formulas.formula: Bhara hua: C = Kε₀A/d.   t moti slab: C = ε₀A / (d − t + t/K).   Metal slab: C = ε₀A / (d − t)
formulas.when: Plates ke beech dielectric/metal.

formulas.name: Combination of capacitors
formulas.formula: Series: 1/C = 1/C₁ + 1/C₂ + …  (sab par Q same).   Parallel: C = C₁ + C₂ + …  (sab par V same)
formulas.when: Capacitor network.
formulas.mistake: Resistors ka ulta: series capacitor ka equivalent sabse chhote se bhi chhota.

formulas.name: Energy stored
formulas.formula: U = ½CV² = Q²/(2C) = ½QV;   energy density u = ½ ε₀ E²  (medium mein ½ε₀KE²)
formulas.when: Capacitor ki energy.

formulas.name: Dielectric inserted — battery ON vs OFF
formulas.formula: Battery ON: V same, C→KC, Q→KQ, U→KU.   Battery OFF: Q same, C→KC, V→V/K, E→E/K, U→U/K
formulas.when: Dielectric daalne ke baad kya badla.

formulas.name: Charge sharing between capacitors
formulas.formula: Common V = (C₁V₁ + C₂V₂)/(C₁ + C₂);   heat loss = C₁C₂(V₁ − V₂)² / [2(C₁ + C₂)]
formulas.when: Charged capacitor ko doosre se jodna.
formulas.note: Energy hamesha ghatti hai (heat/radiation), charge conserve rehta hai.

formulas.name: Induced charge on dielectric and plate force
formulas.formula: Q_induced = Q(1 − 1/K);   attraction between plates F = Q²/(2ε₀A)
formulas.when: Dielectric ki surface par charge; plates ka khinchav.
formulas.mistake: Force mein ½ aata hai (ek plate apne hi field se force nahi leti).

examples.title: Do charges ke beech force
examples.problem: q₁ = +2 μC aur q₂ = −3 μC hawa mein 30 cm door hain. Force kitna aur kaisa?
examples.solution: F = kq₁q₂/r² = 9 × 10⁹ × 2 × 10⁻⁶ × 3 × 10⁻⁶ / (0.3)² = 0.6 N. Charges ulte hain, isliye attraction.

examples.title: Field kahaan zero?
examples.problem: +4q charge x = 0 par aur +q charge x = 30 cm par hai. Unke beech kahaan E = 0 hoga?
examples.solution: Same sign ke charges ke beech, chhote charge ke paas null point hota hai. Point 4q se x door: k(4q)/x² = kq/(30 − x)² ⇒ x/(30 − x) = 2 ⇒ x = 20 cm (yaani q se 10 cm). Ulte sign ke charges hon to null point bahar, chhote charge ki taraf hota hai.

examples.title: Dipole par torque aur kaam
examples.problem: ±2 μC charges 2 cm door hain; dipole E = 5 × 10⁵ N/C se 30° par hai. Torque? Dipole ko 0° se 180° ghumane ka kaam?

examples.title: Cube ke centre par charge
examples.problem: q = 1.77 μC ek cube ke centre par hai. Poore cube aur ek face se flux?
examples.solution: Total Φ = q/ε₀ = 1.77 × 10⁻⁶ / 8.85 × 10⁻¹² ≈ 2.0 × 10⁵ N·m²/C. Symmetry se 6 barabar faces: ek face = q/(6ε₀) ≈ 3.3 × 10⁴ N·m²/C. (Charge cube ke corner par ho to poore cube se flux q/(8ε₀) hota hai; us corner ko chhoone wale 3 faces se flux zero, kyunki field unke parallel hai.)

examples.title: Shell: andar E zero, V nahi
examples.problem: R = 10 cm ke thin shell par Q = 1 nC. Centre par E aur V? 20 cm door V?
examples.solution: Andar E = 0. Andar V = surface wala = kQ/R = 9 × 10⁹ × 10⁻⁹ / 0.1 = 90 V. r = 0.2 m par V = kQ/r = 45 V.

examples.title: Capacitor network
examples.problem: 3 μF aur 6 μF series mein hain; ye jodi 4 μF ke parallel mein hai. 12 V battery se jodo. C_eq, total charge, energy?
examples.solution: Series: 3×6/(3+6) = 2 μF. Parallel: 2 + 4 = 6 μF. Q = CV = 6 × 12 = 72 μC. U = ½CV² = ½ × 6 × 10⁻⁶ × 144 = 432 μJ.

examples.title: Battery hata ke dielectric
examples.problem: 10 pF capacitor 100 V tak charge karke battery hata di. Ab K = 5 dielectric poori jagah bhar diya. Naya V aur energy?
examples.solution: Battery OFF ⇒ Q same = CV = 1 nC. C → 50 pF, V → 100/5 = 20 V. U pehle = ½CV² = 50 nJ, ab = U/K = 10 nJ. Energy ghati — slab andar khinchta hai (external agent ko negative kaam karna padta hai).

examples.title: Charge sharing mein energy loss
examples.problem: 2 μF capacitor 100 V par charged hai; use uncharged 3 μF se jod diya. Common V aur heat loss?
examples.solution: V = C₁V₁/(C₁ + C₂) = 200/5 = 40 V. Pehle U = ½ × 2 × 10⁻⁶ × 100² = 10 mJ; baad mein ½ × 5 × 10⁻⁶ × 40² = 4 mJ. Loss = 6 mJ — formula C₁C₂ΔV²/[2(C₁+C₂)] = 6 × 10⁻¹² × 10⁴ / 10⁻⁵ se bhi yahi.

examples.title: Electron ko 100 V se accelerate
examples.problem: Rest se electron 100 V potential difference se guzarta hai. KE aur speed?

topics.title: Charge aur charging by induction
topics.explain: Charge quantised, conserved aur additive hai. Induction mein charged rod paas laate hain, door wale side ko earth karte hain, earth hatate hain, phir rod — conductor par ulta charge reh jaata hai. Rod ka apna charge kam nahi hota.

topics.title: Electric field lines ke niyam
topics.explain: Positive se nikalti hain, negative mein khatam. Kabhi ek doosre ko kaat-ti nahi (ek point par do direction nahi ho sakti). Ghani lines = strong field. Band loop nahi banati (electrostatics mein). Conductor surface par perpendicular milti hain.

topics.title: Dipole: uniform vs non-uniform field
topics.explain: Uniform field mein dono charges par barabar-ulti force ⇒ net force 0, sirf torque (ghoomega, align hoga). Non-uniform field mein torque ke saath net force bhi — dipole strong field ki taraf khinchta hai (jaise kaagaz ke tukde comb ki taraf).

topics.title: Gauss's law kab aur kaise
topics.explain: Tabhi kaam ka hai jab symmetry ho: line charge → coaxial cylinder, sheet → pillbox, sphere → concentric sphere. Gaussian surface aisi chuno jahaan E har jagah same ho aur surface ke perpendicular (ya parallel). Flux sirf andar ke charge se, field sab charges se.

topics.title: Conductors in electrostatics
topics.explain: Andar E = 0; extra charge sirf bahar ki surface par; surface par E perpendicular aur magnitude σ/ε₀; poora conductor equipotential. Nukeeli jagah σ zyada (isliye lightning conductor nukeela hota hai). Khokhle conductor ke andar (cavity mein charge na ho to) field zero — electrostatic shielding.

topics.title: Potential, potential difference aur energy
topics.explain: V = kaam per unit charge (infinity se laane mein). Do points ka ΔV path par depend nahi karta (conservative field). Positive charge high V se low V ki taraf jaata hai; electron ulta. Field = potential ki dhalaan (−dV/dr).

topics.title: Equipotential surfaces
topics.explain: Jis surface par har jagah V same. Field lines inke perpendicular. In par charge le jaane mein kaam zero. Point charge: concentric spheres; uniform field: parallel planes (field ke perpendicular). Do equipotentials kabhi kaat-ti nahi.

topics.title: Dielectrics aur polarisation
topics.explain: Dielectric = insulator jo field mein polarise hota hai. Polar molecules (H₂O) ke permanent dipoles align hote hain; non-polar (O₂) mein field se dipole induce hota hai. Andar ka field ghat kar E₀/K ho jaata hai, isliye capacitance K guna.

topics.title: Capacitor ka kaam
topics.explain: Do conductors ke beech charge +Q/−Q. C sirf geometry aur medium par depend karta hai, Q ya V par nahi. Energy plates ke beech ki field mein store hoti hai (u = ½ε₀E²).

topics.title: Series vs parallel ka logic
topics.explain: Series mein har capacitor par same Q (beech ki plates par induced charge), V bant-ta hai — chhote C par zyada V. Parallel mein same V, Q bant-ta hai — bade C par zyada Q.

topics.title: Dielectric: battery juddi ya nahi
topics.explain: Juddi ho (V fixed): C, Q, U sab K guna. Hati ho (Q fixed): V, E, U sab K guna kam. Poochhe 'energy kya hui' — battery ON mein battery ne extra kaam kiya, OFF mein energy ghati aur slab andar khincha.

ratta: Field: point 1/r², dipole 1/r³, line 1/r, sheet r se independent.
Shell: andar E = 0, V = kQ/R (constant).  Solid sphere andar E ∝ r.
Dipole: τ = pE sinθ,  U = −pE cosθ,  0 → 180° kaam = 2pE.
Cube centre: ek face q/6ε₀;  cube corner par charge: poora cube q/8ε₀.
Capacitors: series → 1/C jodo (Q same);  parallel → C jodo (V same).
Battery ON: V same → Q, U K guna.  Battery OFF: Q same → V, U K guna kam.
Ring axis par E_max at x = R/√2.
Conductor: andar E = 0, surface par E = σ/ε₀ (perpendicular), poora equipotential.
